# XrealAR

**Inherits:** [`Node`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_node.html)  
**Registered by:** the `godot_xreal` GDExtension  

Scene node that turns the AR change polls + glasses events into signals. See the module docs.

## Properties

<a id="property-active"></a>

### active: bool

Master switch — poll each frame while `true`.

<a id="property-anchors"></a>

### anchors: bool

Poll spatial-anchor changes each frame and emit the `anchor_*` signals.

<a id="property-glasses_events"></a>

### glasses_events: bool

Emit `temperature_changed` / `native_error` on change.

<a id="property-images"></a>

### images: bool

Poll image-tracking changes each frame and emit the `image_*` signals.

<a id="property-mesh"></a>

### mesh: bool

Poll depth-mesh changes each frame and emit the `mesh_block_*` signals.

<a id="property-planes"></a>

### planes: bool

Poll plane-detection changes each frame and emit the `plane_*` signals (turn off the streams you don't use to skip their per-frame native poll).

## Signals

<a id="signal-anchor_added"></a>

### anchor_added(anchor: Dictionary)

A tracked anchor was added — `Dictionary { id, transform, tracking_state, session_id }`.

<a id="signal-anchor_removed"></a>

### anchor_removed(id: String)

A tracked anchor was removed (its id string).

<a id="signal-anchor_updated"></a>

### anchor_updated(anchor: Dictionary)

A tracked anchor was updated (same `Dictionary` shape as `anchor_added`).

<a id="signal-image_added"></a>

### image_added(image: Dictionary)

A tracked image was added — `Dictionary { id, source_image, transform, size, tracking_state }`.

<a id="signal-image_removed"></a>

### image_removed(id: String)

A tracked image was removed (its id string).

<a id="signal-image_updated"></a>

### image_updated(image: Dictionary)

A tracked image was updated (same `Dictionary` shape as `image_added`).

<a id="signal-mesh_block_changed"></a>

### mesh_block_changed(block: Dictionary)

A mesh block was added / updated — `Dictionary { id, state, vertices, normals, indices }`.

<a id="signal-mesh_block_removed"></a>

### mesh_block_removed(id: String)

A mesh block was removed (its id string).

<a id="signal-native_error"></a>

### native_error(code: int, message: String)

A native async error arrived (`XREALErrorCode` + its message).

<a id="signal-plane_added"></a>

### plane_added(plane: Dictionary)

A detected plane was added — `Dictionary { id, transform, center, size, alignment }`.

<a id="signal-plane_removed"></a>

### plane_removed(id: String)

A detected plane was removed (its id string).

<a id="signal-plane_updated"></a>

### plane_updated(plane: Dictionary)

A detected plane was updated (same `Dictionary` shape as `plane_added`).

<a id="signal-temperature_changed"></a>

### temperature_changed(level: int)

The glasses temperature level changed (`0` NORMAL / `1` WARM / `2` HOT).
